questions.title: Does the manual state these troubleshooting facts?

source.text: PROBLEM: Pump fails to operate. | CAUSE: Restricted line or inadequate air supply | SOLUTION: Clear*; see Technical Data on pages 24–27.
PROBLEM: Pump operates, but output is low on both strokes. | CAUSE: Restricted line or inadequate air supply. | SOLUTION: Clear*; see Technical Data on pages 24–27.

proposal: 1. FailureMode 'Restricted line or inadequate air supply' -> AFFECTS -> Component 'Line'. Meaning: The failure mode affects the specified component.

questions.title: Does the manual state these troubleshooting facts?

source.text: PROBLEM (same as row above): Pump fails to operate. | CAUSE: Obstructed fluid hose or gun/valve; fluid hose ID is too small. | SOLUTION: Clear*; use a hose with a larger ID.

PROBLEM (same as row above): Pump operates, but output is low on both strokes. | CAUSE: Obstructed fluid hose or gun/valve; fluid hose ID is too small. | SOLUTION: Clear*; use a hose with a larger ID.

* To determine if the fluid hose or gun is obstructed, follow the Pressure Relief Procedure on page 8. Disconnect the fluid hose and place a container at the pump fluid outlet to catch any fluid. Turn on the air just enough to start the pump (about 20–40 psi [0.14–0.3 MPa, 1.4–2.8 bar]). If the pump starts when the air is turned on, the obstruc- tion is in the fluid hose or gun.

proposal: 1. FailureMode 'Obstructed fluid hose or gun/valve, or fluid hose ID too small' -> RESOLVED_BY -> CorrectiveAction 'Test for fluid hose or gun obstruction' [inspection]. Meaning: For this problem or cause the manual prescribes this check or test (it need not repair anything). Conditions: If the pump starts when air is turned on, the obstruction is in the fluid hose or gun..

answers.text: Keep statement 1 only; the manual does not establish consulting the referenced Technical Data as a prescribed inspection or test.
answers.rationale: The cause explicitly includes a restricted line, supporting the link to Line, while “see Technical Data” is only a reference and does not prescribe a check or test.
Both rows prescribe clearing the restriction and referring to Technical Data, supporting consultation of that data for an inadequate-air-supply cause.
The solution says to clean the displacement rod and refer to the Service section, but it does not prescribe consulting that section as a check or test.

The table’s asterisked “Clear” solution points to the prescribed test, which determines whether the fluid hose or gun is obstructed; this supports the proposed inspection relation for the obstruction cause.

answers.text: The manual says to check the wiper plate seal as the solution; it does not state that the air leak affects the seal.
answers.rationale: The row lists air leaking into the supply container as the cause and checking the wiper plate seal as the solution, not an affected-component relationship.
